---

Might be worth just putting in a quick fix independent of this patch
series just in case.

Let me see if I can quickly whip sth up :)

2026-08-28.patch_summary: This patch series introduces Virtual Swap Space (VSwap), a new feature that allows for efficient and scalable swapping by decoupling swap entries from their backing storage. The current implementation ties swap entries to their backing slot, which can lead to performance issues when swap is used as a cache or when swapoff is frequent. VSwap addresses these issues by introducing a separate data structure for swap entries, allowing for more flexible and efficient management of swap space.
